<MEMORY>
name: feedback-avoid-display-commands
type: feedback
visibility: local
description: Commands that DISPLAY a credential leak it irreversibly into the session transcript - prefer commands that USE one
---
Twice in 24 hours, a live credential leaked into a session transcript through an entirely
ordinary read-only command:

1. a process listing printed a sandbox argv including an injected token
2. a grep over a unit drop-in (to look up a connection string) printed the live password

**Why:** the transcript is transmitted on every turn, so the credential leaves the machine
the instant it is rendered, and no later redaction can recall it.

**Instead:** pipe the value into the command that needs it, or reference the file by path
without printing it.

Related: [[feedback-verify-before-assert]].
</MEMORY>
